mapper.select: select ifnull(auto_increment, 1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database()) and table_name = 'biz_daily_settlement'

select count(distinct o.order_id) as order_count, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as total_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 1 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as cash_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 2 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as wechat_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 3 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as alipay_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 4 then p.pay_amount - ifnull(p.refund_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as stored_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 5 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as campus_amount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(p.refund_amount, 0)), 0) as refund_amount, ifnull(sum(o.point_amount), 0) as point_amount from biz_order o left join biz_payment p on p.order_id = o.order_id where o.settle_id = #{settleId} and o.status <> 5
mapper.update: update biz_order set settle_id = 0, update_time = now() where settle_id in #{id}
update biz_order set is_settled = 1, settle_id = #{settleId}, update_time = now() where settle_id = #{settleId} and status <> 5 and is_settled = 0
